# Role coverage decisions

<!-- Generated by python -m simba_mcp.guidance.coverage. -->

Every registered tool has an explicit decision below. Full/data_scientist include all tools. Profiles select startup catalogues and confer no permissions. Intentional exclusions are valid; use a separate full connection for authoring or cross-role work.

| Family and exact tools | Marketer | Reviewer | Decision and guidance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| visuals_marketer_reviewer: `show_response_curves`, `show_decomposition`, `show_optimizer_allocation` | included | included | Both roles inspect authoritative result JSON; charts preserve gaps and have JSON/text fallback. No prediction access or new calculation. Guidance: results, optimiser. |
| drafts_full_only: `create_recipe_draft`, `get_recipe_draft`, `get_recipe_draft_template`, `publish_recipe_draft`, `list_recipe_drafts`, `update_recipe_draft` | excluded | excluded | Recipe authoring and draft lifecycle belong to full. Reviewer additionally reads published authoring provenance; marketer inspects published evidence instead. Guidance: studies. |
| drafts_reviewer: `get_recipe_revision_authoring` | excluded | included | Recipe authoring and draft lifecycle belong to full. Reviewer additionally reads published authoring provenance; marketer inspects published evidence instead. Guidance: studies. |
| capability_discovery_marketer_reviewer: `get_backend_capabilities` | included | included | Expose operation-specific capability inspection for safe cross-domain planning; absent advertisements stay unknown and confer no permission. Guidance: mmm, studies. |
| dataset_reporting_marketer_reviewer: `get_data_schema`, `get_data_report`, `list_uploads`, `get_upload` | included | included | Existing actual-data reporting needs dataset discovery, exact columns and declared-role schema. Include only these read dependencies; no upload, refresh or fit. Guidance: reporting. |
| data_full_only: `upload_data`, `list_pipeline_versions`, `list_pipelines`, `run_pipeline`, `get_pipeline_run`, `set_pipeline_schedule` | excluded | excluded | Pipeline inspection, refresh and schedule/upload administration belong to full authoring; list_uploads already identifies all stored reporting datasets. Guidance: mmm. |
| campaigns_marketer_reviewer: `list_campaigns`, `get_campaign_report`, `get_campaign_incrementality` | included | included | Both evidence roles need campaign identity, facts and channel-derived incremental evidence. Preserve unmapped spend and platform-versus-incremental attribution. Guidance: campaigns. |
| campaign_budgets_marketer_reviewer: `get_campaign_marginal_returns`, `recommend_campaign_budgets` | included | included | Both evidence roles inspect marginal evidence and conditional read-only budget calculations. POST is read-only, not platform spend authority. Guidance: campaigns. |
| campaign_mapping_marketer: `set_campaign_mapping` | included | excluded | Marketer/full may replace a complete map only with explicit intent. Scientific reviewer inspects evidence and uses full for authoring; no inferred mapping. Guidance: campaigns. |
| incrementality_marketer_reviewer: `list_incrementality_tests`, `get_incrementality_test` | included | included | Both roles read calibration evidence; marketer/full record or import explicitly authorised tests. Reviewer uses full for test-record authoring. Guidance: campaigns, mmm. |
| experiment_screening_marketer_reviewer: `recommend_incrementality_tests` | included | included | Both evidence roles need inspectable screening and exclusions; scores are not test design, benefit or budget recommendations. Guidance: campaigns. |
| incrementality_marketer: `create_incrementality_test`, `import_incrementality_tests` | included | excluded | Both roles read calibration evidence; marketer/full record or import explicitly authorised tests. Reviewer uses full for test-record authoring. Guidance: campaigns, mmm. |
| models_marketer_reviewer: `list_models`, `get_contribution_groups`, `get_model`, `get_model_status` | included | included | Both roles inspect saved model/status and contribution identity. Model creation, VAR links, grouping changes, deletion and model administration belong to full. Guidance: mmm, results, var, priors. |
| models_full_only: `create_model`, `create_var_model`, `link_var_model`, `unlink_var_model`, `set_contribution_groups`, `rename_model`, `save_model`, `unsave_model`, `delete_model` | excluded | excluded | Both roles inspect saved model/status and contribution identity. Model creation, VAR links, grouping changes, deletion and model administration belong to full. Guidance: mmm, results, var, priors. |
| projects_marketer_reviewer: `list_projects` | included | included | Both roles discover existing project identity. Project creation/renaming are administration and require full. Guidance: mmm, studies. |
| projects_full_only: `create_project`, `rename_project` | excluded | excluded | Both roles discover existing project identity. Project creation/renaming are administration and require full. Guidance: mmm, studies. |
| results_marketer_reviewer: `get_model_results` | included | included | Both roles need saved evidence and selection metadata; interpretation preserves units, attribution and missingness. Guidance: results. |
| scenarios_marketer: `run_optimizer`, `run_scenario`, `update_run`, `set_run_pinned` | included | excluded | Both roles inspect saved plans/templates/history. Marketer/full submit authorised plans and curate exact runs; reviewer uses full before planning writes. Guidance: optimiser. |
| scenarios_marketer_reviewer: `get_optimizer_results`, `get_scenario_template`, `get_scenario_results`, `list_runs` | included | included | Both roles inspect saved plans/templates/history. Marketer/full submit authorised plans and curate exact runs; reviewer uses full before planning writes. Guidance: optimiser. |
| studies_marketer_reviewer: `list_studies`, `get_study`, `get_study_overview`, `list_study_runs`, `get_study_run` | included | included | Both roles inspect saved Studies/runs. Governance, adoption, launch and cancellation belong to full authoring with independent budgets. Guidance: studies. |
| studies_full_only: `create_study`, `get_launch_eligibility`, `update_study`, `launch_study_run`, `cancel_study_run`, `adopt_model_into_study` | excluded | excluded | Both roles inspect saved Studies/runs. Governance, adoption, launch and cancellation belong to full authoring with independent budgets. Guidance: studies. |
| recipes_marketer_reviewer: `list_study_recipes`, `get_recipe_revision`, `diff_recipe_revisions` | included | included | Both roles inspect immutable recipes and diffs. Revision/refreeze/validation and creation belong to full authoring with declared prerequisites. Guidance: studies. |
| recipes_full_only: `create_study_recipe`, `revise_study_recipe`, `refreeze_recipe_revision`, `validate_study_recipe` | excluded | excluded | Both roles inspect immutable recipes and diffs. Revision/refreeze/validation and creation belong to full authoring with declared prerequisites. Guidance: studies. |
| quality_marketer_reviewer: `list_quality_policies`, `diff_quality_policies`, `get_quality_policy`, `list_study_evaluations`, `list_study_decisions`, `get_study_champion`, `get_study_prediction_access`, `get_study_validation_resolutions`, `compare_study_runs` | included | included | Both roles inspect policies, comparisons and saved evidence. Reviewer/full record authorised assessments, evidence-use declarations and recommendations; policy changes need full. Guidance: studies. |
| quality_full_only: `create_quality_policy`, `retire_quality_policy` | excluded | excluded | Both roles inspect policies, comparisons and saved evidence. Reviewer/full record authorised assessments, evidence-use declarations and recommendations; policy changes need full. Guidance: studies. |
| quality_reviewer: `evaluate_study_run`, `declare_study_holdout_use`, `assess_study_validation_pair`, `recommend_study_run` | excluded | included | Both roles inspect policies, comparisons and saved evidence. Reviewer/full record authorised assessments, evidence-use declarations and recommendations; policy changes need full. Guidance: studies. |
| guidance_marketer_reviewer: `get_workflow_guidance` | included | included | Every role needs bounded packaged workflow guidance and explicit full fallback. Guidance does not authorise operations. Guidance: mmm, results, studies. |
